item.title: TICKET NEWS | Bristol City (A) on sale to supporters from Friday
item.description: Tickets for our away fixture against Bristol City on Tuesday, February 17th, will go on sale to supporters from 10am on Friday, January 30th. item.title: LOANED OUT | Conor Coady signs for Charlton Athletic on loan
item.description: Wrexham AFC can confirm that defender Conor Coady will join Charlton Athletic on loan until the end of the 2025/26 season. Coady, 32, has made six appearances in total so far this season, and now heads to South-East London for the remainder of the campaign. Nathan Jones’ side sit 19th in the Championship table, as the Addicks aim to secure their Championship status following promotion from League One last season. item.title: LOANED OUT | Paul Mullin heads to Bradford City
item.description: Wrexham AFC can confirm striker Paul Mullin has signed on loan for Bradford City until the end of the 2025/26 season. Back-to-back-to-back promotion winner Mullin, 31, started the season on loan with Wigan Athletic – scoring five goals. He returned to the Club in January, and will now spend the remainder of the season with Graham Alexander’s Bantams – who currently sit in the play-off places in League One.
